---
description: Session wrap-up checklist — reload context, sync docs/status, gate on ambiguity.
agent: agent
---

1. Reload all mandatory files for the current read profile that are not completely in your context window.
2. Update all relevant docs (*.md files, issues, PRs, etc.) with current status, work done, changes made, and next steps as needed.
3. Stop, ask, recommend and explain reasoning if you have any questions, concerns, or if anything is ambiguous.
